value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the canonical rhombic dodecahedron, the classical Catalan dual of the cuboctahedron, whose two vertex radii make Euclidean and graph-metric Rips filtrations differ. The sharp five transitions include genuinely changing sphere dimensions \(S^2\), \(S^3\) and \(S^6\); the 80-pair inclusion-preserving collapse and full octahedral orientation characters explain how its two vertex orbits interact. The exact integral persistence barcode is a motivated invariant and not a numerical table or routine renormalization of a Platonic result. The statement is finite and self-contained; it does not claim a broad Catalan theorem.
